title: Malmgren on his deathbed: CIA and the Majestic tracked him

tellings.quote: hospital on his deathbed, but he goes that was when the CIA started tracking me. They put my name in some file and he goes them and the Majestic.

plain: A man named Harold Malmgren, speaking from a hospital bed near the end of his life, told Michels that the CIA had started tracking him, putting his name in a file, and that "the Majestic" did too. The Majestic is a rumoured secret group said to handle UFO matters at the top of the US government. Michels tells it as something he heard from Malmgren directly, and it would mean such a group kept watch on people from the 1950s on.
